name: Staff of Striking
description: A quarterstaff of ironwood, its ends shod in dented bronze.
body:
## What it does

In the hand it fights as a magic quarterstaff that strikes truer and harder than any plain one. When it lands, you can pour its stored force into the blow.

## Charges

It holds ten charges and gathers some back each dawn. Spend the last one and it may lose its magic for good.

damage.note: for each charge spent when it hits, up to 3

features.name: Striking
features.text: Used as a magic quarterstaff, it gives +3 to attack and damage rolls made with it.

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it becomes a plain quarterstaff
